facts.fact: The document is the text of the Access to Information Act, 2022 (Act No. 8 of 2022), promulgated in Government Gazette 7986 on 28 December 2022; it gives a right of access to information held by public and private entities, and commences on a date the Minister sets by Gazette notice (section 86), with no commencement date stated as of the page's 2026-08-09 check.
